[[Nom Anor]] [[Bioengineering/Legends|created]] a type of '''organism''' that could inflate itself into a wedge shape. The [[Executor/Legends|Executor]] used these to make a ceiling trap near his lair on [[Duro/Legends|Duro]] that collapsed on [[Mara Jade Skywalker]] and [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] when the organisms inflated, breaking apart the ceiling.
